vuln_id: OSS-Fuzz issue 14040 / ARVO arvo:14040 / qtbase qpnghandler scaledSize use-of-uninitialized-value

staged_source_snapshot.description: Stage 01 reproduced against this local vulnerable workspace. The staged `kra.cpp`, `qpnghandler.cpp`, and `qsize.h` line map matches the saved MemorySanitizer trace. The staged `kzip.cpp` patch remains only contextual evidence because the available source and runtime artifacts do not establish a concrete source-level bridge from KZip parsing state into the witnessed Qt uninitialized read.

bug_description.original: Detailed report: https://oss-fuzz.com/testcase?key=5660050997116928 Project: kimageformats Fuzzer: libFuzzer_kimageformats_kimgio_fuzzer Fuzz target binary: kimgio_fuzzer Job Type: libfuzzer_msan_kimageformats Platform Id: linux Crash Type: Use-of-uninitialized-value Crash Address: Crash State: QPngHandlerPrivate::readPngImage QPngHandler::read QImageReader::read Sanitizer: memory (MSAN)
bug_description.normalized: The saved witness reaches `KraHandler::read`, opens the attacker-controlled buffer as a KRA ZIP container, extracts `mergedimage.png`, and asks Qt to decode it as PNG. In the staged vulnerable Qt source, `QPngHandlerPrivate` contains member `QSize scaledSize;` with no constructor initialization, and `readPngImage` passes that member by value to `setup_qt`. `setup_qt` then reads that copied `QSize` in the downscaling predicate at lines 396-397 and later compares `image.size() != outSize` at line 403. The saved MemorySanitizer trace proves that the crashing run read an uninitialized `width.i` originating in `QPngHandlerPrivate::readPngImage` and reported the sink at `setup_qt` line 403 via `operator!=`. The staged KZip patch fixes a separate short-read extra-field parsing bug, but the available Stage 01 evidence and staged source do not establish a concrete source-level transfer from that KZip state into Qt's uninitialized `scaledSize`, so this GT remains anchored to the witnessed Qt-side use of uninitialized state rather than asserting an unsupported cross-subsystem bridge.

source.description: First project-side statement on the witnessed crashing path that consumes attacker-controlled archive member bytes into the vulnerable Qt decode flow. This call materializes the attacker's `mergedimage.png` entry as PNG input for `QImageReader` and `QPngHandler`.
source.value_from: The Stage 01 reproduction and saved MSan trace show the same witness input reaches `KraHandler::read()` and then `QPngHandlerPrivate::readPngImage()` through `QImage::loadFromData(..., "PNG")`.

tainted_value_origin.description: The attacker-controlled `mergedimage.png` member bytes are materialized here as the PNG payload consumed by the later Qt-side uninitialized-value path.

root_cause.description: Missing initialization of member `scaledSize`. The constructor initializes several fields but leaves `QSize scaledSize;` untouched, so later reads in the PNG decode path can observe uninitialized width and height values.
root_cause.note: The staged class declaration places `QSize scaledSize;` at line 109, and the saved MSan origin reports that the undefined value came from stack allocation of `width.i` in `QPngHandlerPrivate::readPngImage`, which is consistent with an uninitialized `QSize` being copied into that frame and then read.

sink.description: MemorySanitizer crash site. `operator!=` on `QSize` reads an uninitialized width field while comparing `image.size()` with `outSize` inside `setup_qt`.
sink.note: The saved trace reports `use-of-uninitialized-value` in `operator!=` at `qsize.h:173`, called from `setup_qt` line 403, and names `width.i` allocated in `QPngHandlerPrivate::readPngImage` line 587 as the origin in that frame. The available evidence does not prove that the earlier `outSize = scaledSize` assignment executed on the crashing run.

parser_admitted.description: The witness is admitted as a KRA ZIP archive far enough that `KraHandler` resolves the required `mergedimage.png` member instead of returning at `!zip.open(...)` or `!entry || !entry->isFile()`.

evidence_limitations: Stage 02 stayed source-grounded as required and did not rerun the PoC or add runtime probes beyond the saved Stage 01 artifacts.

The saved MSan artifact proves the final uninitialized read inside Qt and names the Qt frame that created the undefined value, but it does not identify a concrete upstream subsystem transfer that set up that Qt state.

The staged source shows additional reads of the copied `scaledSize` in the downscaling predicate at `setup_qt:396-397`, but the saved artifacts do not prove that the branch body at lines 398-401 executed on the crashing run; this GT therefore does not claim that `outSize` was assigned from `scaledSize` before the sink.

The staged patch fixes a real KZip short-read extra-field parsing bug, but the available source and runtime evidence do not close a concrete value-flow bridge from that KZip bug into `QPngHandlerPrivate::scaledSize`; this GT therefore does not claim that connection.

coarse_trace.summary: The harness wraps the attacker-controlled bytes in a `QBuffer`, attaches it to `KraHandler`, and calls `read`, which attempts to parse the buffer as a KRA image.
KRA parsing opens the ZIP container, resolves `mergedimage.png`, and forwards that member's bytes to `QImage::loadFromData(..., "PNG")`.
Qt's PNG handler keeps member `scaledSize` uninitialized and later passes it by value into `setup_qt` during PNG decoding.
`setup_qt` reads the copied `QSize` in the downscaling predicate and then triggers the recorded MSan report when `operator!=` reads an uninitialized width field during `image.size() != outSize`.

fine_trace.note: The harness places the witness bytes into a `QBuffer` and invokes `KraHandler::read` on that device. This is unscored harness plumbing, but it establishes that the same input stream later decoded as PNG comes directly from the witness.
Source. After `zip.open(QIODevice::ReadOnly)` and lookup of `mergedimage.png` succeed, the handler materializes attacker-controlled archive member bytes as PNG decoder input.
Root cause. The PNG handler object is constructed with member `scaledSize` left uninitialized because the constructor initializes other members but does not assign `scaledSize`.

fine_trace.code: setup_qt(*outImage, png_ptr, info_ptr, scaledSize, &doScaledRead, gamma, fileGamma);
fine_trace.note: `readPngImage` passes member `scaledSize` by value into `setup_qt`. This copies the still-uninitialized `QSize` fields into the callee's `scaledSize` parameter on the crashing path.

fine_trace.code:
if (!scaledSize.isEmpty() && quint32(scaledSize.width()) <= width &&
    quint32(scaledSize.height()) <= height && interlace_method == PNG_INTERLACE_NONE) {
fine_trace.note: `setup_qt` reads the copied `scaledSize` in the downscaling predicate by evaluating `isEmpty()`, `width()`, and `height()`. These are source-level reads of the same uninitialized `QSize` state, but the saved artifacts do not prove the branch body executed.

Sink. `operator!=` on `QSize` reads an uninitialized width field while comparing `image.size()` with `outSize`, matching the saved MemorySanitizer report at `qsize.h:173` and `setup_qt:403`. `outSize` is known to exist from `QSize outSize(width,height);`, but this GT does not assert that the earlier `outSize = scaledSize` assignment happened on the crashing run.

depends_on.via: copied uninitialized QSize reaches setup_qt frame

allocation_context.note: The saved MSan origin says the uninitialized value was created by stack allocation of `width.i` in `QPngHandlerPrivate::readPngImage` at line 587.

cross_validation.notes: Stage 02 is source-grounded only. No fixed-version or differential runtime validation was performed in this role.

poc.trigger: Decode the witness as a KRA archive whose `mergedimage.png` member reaches Qt PNG handling, then `setup_qt` reads the uninitialized `scaledSize` state and later triggers MSan when `operator!=` reads an uninitialized `QSize` field.

format.name: KRA with embedded PNG
format.contract: The witness must be accepted by `KraHandler::read` as a ZIP-based KRA archive with a file entry `mergedimage.png`, and that member's bytes must reach Qt's PNG decoder so that `QPngHandlerPrivate::readPngImage` calls `setup_qt` with an uninitialized `scaledSize`.

delivery.input_mechanism: libFuzzer passes the witness bytes directly as the `data,size` buffer; the harness copies them into a `QBuffer` and gives that device to `KraHandler`.
